purpose: Published test vectors for family 9's protocol core (src/tasks/nostr), and the specifications family 9 cites, each pinned by commit and SHA-256. The vector files are copied byte for byte; the specifications are cited, not copied.

public domain (the repository's README, for the TypeScript implementation and vectors copied from nostr-protocol/nips)
vectors.note: This SHA-256 is the checksum NIP-44 publishes for the file. The file predates the NIP-44 amendment of 2026-06-28 (nips #1907) that admits plaintexts of 65,536 bytes or more, and still lists 65536, 100000, and 10000000 under invalid.encrypt_msg_lengths. The bench follows the amended text; see docs/tasks.md §10.8.

vectors.derived: The keys and the two go-nostr payloads of the tests 'decrypt message from go-nostr' and 'decrypt big payload from go-nostr', transcribed and checked against the source file by script (source SHA-256 fc4965cb46fb5f2168aa47cb49172604fef2e9432351216d79e58c05e377ac64). NIP-04 publishes no vectors of its own; these are a second implementation's output.

The three keys and three JSON blocks of the section 'An Example', extracted by script; one trailing comma in the wrap block was removed so that the block parses. Source file SHA-256 b46b078ff5b219fd4ab33a53b479b49d4cbd604b88be46d6b978d53d8f8b43a0.
